Container.Name: Network List Sync

Branch.TagDescription: Latest commits from the main branch

Container.Description:
Fully integrated web UI for keeping firewall and address groups in sync.
Combines DNS hostnames, static CIDRs, and URL-based IP/CIDR feeds into scheduled sync jobs with run-history diffs so you can see exactly what changed. Useful for dynamic sources such as Cloudflare IPv4/IPv6 lists: https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v4. Core features include multi-resolver lookups, job scheduling, change tracking, and centralized list/group management from one interface. Currently supports UniFi and NGINX Proxy Manager. See the repository for documentation and to report issues: https://github.com/mstrhakr/network-list-sync/issues
